_comment: Copy this to ground_truth.json and replace the entries with your own receipts.
ground_truth.json is gitignored on purpose: it describes real receipts, and the
images it labels live in backend/img/, which is also untracked.
Keys are filenames in the images directory. date is DD/MM/YYYY, time is HH:MM:SS,
amount is a bare decimal with no currency. note is free text for your own reference.

receipt-01.jpg.note: Thermal receipt. Time is printed 12-hour, so the model has to resolve PM.

receipt-02.jpg.note: E-wallet payment screen. The amount is a headline figure with no total label.
